high_level_description: The image depicts an Airbus Beluga aircraft, also known as the "Flying Whale," in flight. The aircraft is captured from a side angle, showcasing its distinctive fuselage shape and large size. The text on the aircraft reads "AIRBUS BELUGA" in bold blue letters, with the number "4" prominently displayed on the nose of the plane. The setting appears to be an open sky with a clear blue backdrop, suggesting good weather conditions. Below the aircraft, there is a building with a sloped roof and what looks like a covered area or hangar structure.
